title: Prototype Spaceflight Health Context
author: Prototype knowledge base
description: Illustrative approved context for prototype usage. This is not a real NASA publication and must not be treated as a clinical finding.
content: Spaceflight can affect sleep quality, circadian rhythms, and cardiovascular responses. Monitoring systems should interpret trends carefully and avoid claiming a diagnosis from a single measurement. Simulated data should be labeled as such.

title: Prototype Digital Twin and Monitoring Principles
author: Prototype knowledge base
description: Illustrative approved context for the prototype digital twin and health monitoring workflow.
content: A digital twin is a model that reflects current understanding of a system using available measurements and context. It should be used to explain patterns, not to assign medical diagnoses without validation.
